profile.headline: Senior Control Software Engineer @ Commonwealth Fusion Systems
profile.summary:
Embedded Software Engineer currently working at Amazon Lab126 on the development of products based on cutting-edge technologies. Mainly focus on BSP development in order to integrate hardware with software layers.

I started my career with a main focus on the development of Industrial Automation solutions for different industries. Being open to new challenges and willingness to learn new skills took me where I am right now.

positions.title: Embedded Software Development Engineer II
positions.description: Embedded Software development for Lab126 products, mainly Amazon Astro, with focus on BSP (board support packages) development. Including board bringup, kernel drivers development for peripherals, Camera pipeline development, battery charging logic and communication between different SoCs, sensors and other components.
positions.insights: Skills: Android System Programming · Linux · C++ · C · Java · Robot Operating System (ROS) · Camera Pipeline · Kernel Drivers · I2C · Board bringup · Yocto Project

positions.title: Control Systems SDE II
positions.description: Development of tools to facilitate the deployment of Automation Workcells based on AWS Solutions using services such as IoT Core, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, Cloudwatch, CodePipeline, CodeBuild, etc.

positions.title: Control Systems Engineer
positions.description: Support to the deployment of automation technologies to new sites built by Amazon in Europe as well as updating legacy technologies in existing sites. These technologies include Sortation Warehouse Control Systems, Sortation Robotics applications, Packaging applications and many others in the logistics sector.

positions.title: PLC Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Pamplona, Chartered Community of Navarre, Spain
positions.description: Development of Controls applications for PLC, Microcontrollers and PCs integrated in EVA (Automatic Vision Evaluator, machine developed by the company). Control of robotic system implemented with servo and DC motors mainly. Development of the OPC UA client software for application communications between PLC and monitoring software.
positions.insights: Skills: PLC Programming · Motion Control · Microcontrollers · OPC Unified Architecture (OPC UA) · C# · C++

positions.title: Industrial Automation Engineer
positions.description: Development of Industrial Automation projects mainly in the field of infrastructures and remote monitoring of devices via SCADA systems.
positions.insights: Skills: SCADA · Siemens Tia Portal · Schneider Electrics PLC · Wonderware

positions.title: International Applications Engineer
positions.description: Development of Control Systems based on Programable Logic Controllers (PLC) to control industrial machinery in different fields such as Plastics Processing, Glass Processing, Robotics, CNC technology and Digital Printing Industry among others. The software developed included PLC software, HMI and Motion Control. Multiple standards from the industry used such as TCP/IP, OPC UA, Modbus, Powerlink, IO Link, etc. All projects were developed onsite with customers in multiple locations worldwide including Germany, Israel, Turkey, China and Italy.
positions.insights: Skills: PLC Programming · HMI Programming · HMI Design · Motion Control · CNC Programming · Robotics · IEC 1131-3 · ANSI C · B&R Automation Technologies · Low-Level Design · Troubleshooting real time systems

educations.degreeName: Master of Science in Automation and Industrial Electronics
Bachelor of Science in Industrial Electronics
